theme: AF-2 move checker: match arms are alternatives
text: CHECKER (move check, all engines): match arms are now checked as alternatives. A value moved in one arm is no longer treated as moved in the next arm, and after the match each name takes the join of the arms that fall through (moved if any of them moved it). An arm or loop body that always returns or exits, with no break/continue escaping it, no longer moves its values for the code after it, so `return p` in an arm and `return xs` inside `for x in xs` stop giving E0601/E0602 (O-HX3-02, O-HX3-03). A match guard's moves now count for every later arm, and a program that moves a value on one arm and uses it afterwards (it ran before only because the interpreter shares values) is now E0601. The 700 tracked .ax files check identically before and after. What a program computes is unchanged.
